svg.title: PIRITORI TO EDEN — every layer
svg.desc: Era I Kallio: corridors that carry service, real HSL rail geometry and stops, the board's anchors, edges, sites and portals, with an information column giving counts, services, provenance and known gaps.
svg.text: the board’s corridor graph — 24 edges, anchor to
real HSL rail — 40 line directions, shared
real HSL stops — 271 in the box, unlabelled at
Trams 2, 4, 5 and 10 reach the extract box but never enter
Kallio — nearest is 554 m. Six trams and the metro is the
ERA I — 2003, AS THE BOARD HAS IT
Both inferred tram routes are corroborated by the modern lines
that still run on the same rails — §10.5.
WHAT THIS MAP DOES NOT KNOW
· L0 is corridors that carry service, NOT a street map. Any
street with no route on it is absent.
· anchorSequence means PASSES, not CALLS AT. The metro runs
under Karhupuisto and stops at Hakaniemi and Sörnäinen only.
· Line colours are ours, not HSL’s — HSL draws every tram one
green and lets the number do the work.
